components.name: customizations-editor
components.title: Customizations editor
components.description: The Customizations editor (`AICustomizationManagementEditor`, `.ai-customization-management-editor`): a horizontal split with the section sidebar (Browse home button, then Plugins, MCP Servers, Skills, Instructions, Agents, Hooks, Tools with counts, a separator and Extensions) and the content pane for the selected section. It's the same editor whether it's hosted in the modal (`<vsc-modal-editor>`) or as a tab in the Agents window's docked editor part (`<vsc-agents-editor-part>`).
components.usage: Host inside <vsc-modal-editor> (the default Agents window experience) or <vsc-agents-editor-part> (useModal: off, docked right panel, where the sidebar sits at its 150px minimum). Give the host a height. Put one page per section in the default slot with a `section` attribute, before system.js upgrades the element. The section sash is draggable like the product's SplitView. `ds.sash(el, { start, move(dx), end, reset })` (defined here) makes any `.monaco-sash.vertical` draggable the same way, e.g. for a prototype's own part sashes.

attributes.name: sidebar-width
attributes.description: Requested section sidebar width in px (200 default, 150 minimum, 350 maximum). Dragging the sash updates it.

attributes.name: counts
attributes.description: Counts for Plugins, MCP Servers, Skills, Instructions, Agents, Hooks, Tools.

attributes.name: list-focused
attributes.description: Start with the section list marked `last-focused` (as after returning to Browse from a section).

slots.description: Section pages (<vsc-customization-browse section="browse">, <vsc-customization-list section="skills">, …); only the page matching `section` is shown.

states.name: section-selected
states.trigger: Click a section row or the Browse home button; fires `section-change`. Updates in place, so pages keep their state.

states.name: resizing
states.trigger: Drag the sash between sidebar and content (sidebar 150–350px, content ≥ 400px); fires `sidebar-resize`. Double-click the sash to reset to 200px. When the editor narrows, the sidebar shrinks first.

components.name: session-view
components.title: Session view
components.description: Agents window session view: the ancestors the Agents composer's CSS is scoped to (`.part.sessionspart … .session-view …`). `variant="session"` is an open session's chat (`.chat-view.chat-view-chat.experimental-session-composer > .chat-view-widget > .interactive-session`); `variant="new"` is the new-session view (`.chat-view.chat-view-new > .sessions-chat-widget > .new-chat-widget-container`). These ancestors carry no captured styles of their own, so the view takes the size of its container.
components.usage: Wrap Agents window composers: `<vsc-workbench window="agents"><vsc-session-view><vsc-chat-input variant="session">` for an open session, `<vsc-session-view variant="new"><vsc-chat-input variant="new-session">` for the new-session view. Give it a width (the composer is 800-880px wide in the product).

components.name: modal-editor

This is how the Agents window shows Customizations by default (`workbench.editor.useModal: some`).

components.name: notification-toasts
components.title: Notification toasts
components.description: The workbench's notification toast stack (`.monaco-workbench > .notifications-toasts`): pinned to the bottom-right (or bottom-left / top-right) corner, newest toast on top, at most 3 toasts (NotificationsToasts.MAX_NOTIFICATIONS). Uses the modern-UI insets from notificationsDialogs.css (--modern-ui-notifications-inline-inset / -block-end-inset, 8px / 36px by default, 32px bottom with .nostatusbar on the workbench). The Agents window sets both insets to 8px (sessions/browser/media/workbench.css); set those variables on the workbench to match. Position rules are captured for bottom-right and for bottom-left with no status bar.
components.usage: Place once as a direct child of <vsc-workbench> and call show({ severity, message, buttons, source }) to raise toasts. Set position="bottom-left" to match workbench.notifications.position. Add the nostatusbar class to the workbench when the window has no status bar. For the Agents window also set --modern-ui-notifications-inline-inset and --modern-ui-notifications-block-end-inset to var(--vscode-spacing-size80) on the workbench.

components.name: agents-editor-part
components.title: Agents docked editor part
components.description: The Agents window's docked editor part on the right (`#workbench.parts.editor.part.editor` under `.dock-detail-panel`, inside the workbench `.monaco-grid-view`): a connected tab bar (e.g. Changes · Files · Customizations, the + Add Tab dropdown and Maximize Editor Area) above the active editor. With `workbench.editor.useModal: off`, editors such as Customizations open here as a tab instead of in a modal (captured from VS Code Insiders 1.145.0, 2026-10-29 build). Verification: 874 elements compared against the live docked Skills page in both themes; the only differences are the virtualized list's total scroll height (the product sizes `.monaco-list-rows` for all 32 skills; the example lists the User group) and an invisible disabled sash that belongs to the hidden auxiliary bar.
components.usage: Right-hand docked editor area of the Agents window. Wrap in <vsc-workbench window="agents"> and give it a height. Set `tabs` and `active`; listen for `tab-select`, `tab-close` and `tab-add` events to make tabs interactive. Put the active editor in the default slot.

components.name: chat-question-carousel
components.title: Chat question carousel
components.description: The chat question carousel ("ask user a question" widget): an agent's question with a header (optional carousel message, title, skip and collapse buttons), a scrollable answer area (optional detailed message, numbered single- or multi-select options or a text input, plus a numbered "Enter custom answer" row) and a footer with the submit hint and Submit button. Captured from VS Code's own component fixtures (chatQuestionCarousel.fixture.ts) with the Dark 2026 theme. The fixture's Light variant uses Light Modern, and its rules are identical, so Light 2026 colors come from this system's tokens. The answer area's height is set from JS like the product (port of layoutInputScrollable). Known verification drift, limited to the invisible DomScrollableElement scrollbars: their sliders get 4px corners from the workbench's .modern-ui class (the fixture page lacks it; the real Agents window has it), and the fixture's vertical bar height (16px taller) is stale from before the answer area is constrained. Everything visible matches with 0 diffs.
components.usage: Use when an agent asks the user a question in chat (askQuestions tool / MCP elicitation). Put it inside <vsc-chat-view>. Give the question with question= (or slot="question" for bold/links), optional message= above it and slot="detail" for longer context; add <vsc-chat-question-option label description selected> children for choices (multi for checkboxes). Listen for the "submit" event (detail.answer) and "skip". Don't use it for tool or terminal approvals; those are confirmation widgets.

components.name: chat-tool-call
components.title: Chat tool call
components.description: One completed tool call in a chat response (`.chat-thinking-tool-wrapper`): a compact codicon and a past-tense message, optionally followed by a file pill. With `edit`, it renders the edited-file row ("Edited" + file pill with +added/-removed line counts).
components.usage: Inside <vsc-chat-tool-chain>. Children are the message (inline HTML like <strong>/<code> allowed), e.g. "Ran npm test". Pick a compact codicon matching the tool: search-compact, book-compact (read), pencil (edit), terminal-compact (shell), tools (other).

attributes.name: icon
attributes.description: Codicon name, e.g. search-compact, book-compact, pencil, terminal-compact

attributes.name: file
attributes.description: File shown as a pill after the message (or the edited file with edit)

attributes.name: edit
attributes.description: Render the edited-file row (status label + file pill with line counts)

attributes.name: added
attributes.description: Lines added (edit)

attributes.name: removed
attributes.description: Lines removed (edit)

attributes.name: running
attributes.description: In progress: the icon becomes a spinning loading codicon (present-tense message)

components.name: action-list
components.title: Action list
components.description: Action widget dropdown (`.context-view > .action-widget > .actionList > .monaco-list`): the list every Agents window picker opens. Rows are 24px, 48px with a detail line, separators 8px; rows can carry an icon, badge, description, detail, keybinding, a hover toolbar (e.g. a summary button or a gear) and an inline switch. The width is measured from the widest row and clamped to min-width/max-width, like ActionList.computeMaxWidth. Hover and arrow keys move the highlight; Enter/click fires `select`, Escape or clicking outside fires `dismiss`. Open one anchored to an element with `ds.actionList.open(anchor, { items, onSelect, … })`; the Agents pickers (<vsc-session-picker>, <vsc-chat-mode-picker>, …) use it with their real data from ds.chatPickers. The monaco list's runtime id is normalized to `list_id_7` in the captures.
components.usage: Usually opened by a picker, not placed by hand: `ds.actionList.open(anchorElement, { items, label, listClass, widgetClass, role, itemRole, minWidth, maxWidth, maxHeight, onSelect(item) /* return true to keep it open */, onToolbar, onToggle, onClose })`. Items: `{ id, label, icon, description, detail, badge, keybinding, checked, focused, disabled, hover, class, custom, role, expanded, toolbar: [{ icon | label, ariaLabel }], toggle }` or `{ type: "separator" }`. Can also be placed statically with an `items` JSON attribute (and `x`/`y`). Needs <vsc-workbench window="agents">.

components.description: A notification toast (bottom-right / bottom-left stack in the workbench): severity icon, message, toolbar (⚙ More Actions when configure, expand/collapse chevron, ✕ Clear) and, while expanded, a details row with "Source: …" and buttons (first primary). Mirrors NotificationsToasts + NotificationRenderer (notificationsViewer.ts): compact 34px modern-ui rows, wrapped messages grow the row by their extra lines, notifications with buttons are always expanded, slide/fade-in and severity-based auto-dismiss. Captured from VS Code Insiders (serve-web) toasts in Dark 2026 and Light 2026; the runtime list id is normalized to list_id_7 (unused by other lists in this system). Known verification drift: the error and warning references were not the last toast in their stack, where modern UI drops the bottom margin (`:not(:last-child)`), so the single-toast examples are 4px taller.
components.usage: Inside <vsc-notification-toasts> (a direct child of <vsc-workbench>). Prefer toasts.show({ severity, message, buttons, source }) from script; it returns the element. Listen for "action" (detail.label) and "close". Use buttons for actions like "Undo"; leave source empty for product (core) notifications. Not for blocking questions: use <vsc-dialog>.

components.name: chat-input
components.title: Chat input
components.description: The chat composer, in three layouts. Default: the workbench Chat view input (toolbar row under the editor: add context, agent, model, tools; send; secondary toolbar: session target, permissions). variant="session": the Agents window composer in an open session, one row with Add Context, the harness's session controls (Copilot: Mode | Permissions; Claude: Approvals; Codex: Agent Mode + Approvals), the model picker (provider icon, model, effort · context), Dictation/Voice and Send, with the context window usage ring at the top right. variant="new-session": the new-session composer (sessions.chat.experimental.newSessionComposerLayout), the session options strip (environment, workspace, isolation | branch, harness) above the same input with the "Pitch your idea" placeholder. In the Agents layouts every picker opens its real options (ds.chatPickers: harnesses, environments, workspaces, models with effort/context/pricing, modes and permissions, captured from the signed-in product); choices update the composer and fire `change`.
components.usage: Default layout: inside <vsc-chat-view> (`<vsc-chat-view><vsc-chat-input>`); pass items with slot="toolbar" / slot="secondary" to customize. Agents window: `<vsc-workbench window="agents">` + `<vsc-session-view><vsc-chat-input variant="session">` for an open session, or `<vsc-session-view variant="new"><vsc-chat-input variant="new-session">` for a new one; set harness/model/mode/permissions/environment/workspace to start from a given state. Typing enables send; listen for `change` to react to picker choices.

components.name: customization-browse
components.title: Customization Browse page
components.description: The Browse page of the Customizations editor when marketplace discovery is on (`chat.customizations.marketplace.enabled`): a rounded panel with the "Browse customizations" title, Add Customization menu button, description with Learn more, the marketplace search box (filter action) with the source picker (All Sources), and the scrolling list of discovery sections.
